### NAME

`trojai-toolkit` - TrojAI toolkit — NIST-rounded synthetic trojaned-dataset and trojaned-model generation for backdoor research.

### SYNOPSIS

Not derived automatically - see [upstream documentation](https://github.com/trojai/trojai). This page does not
hand-copy flags (generation contract, ADR-0001).

### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

This is the top-level TrojAI module.  It contains two submodules: `datagen` and `modelgen`. `datagen` contains the necessary API functions to quickly generate synthetic data that could be used for training machine learning models. The `modelgen` module contains the necessary API functions to quickly generate DNN models from the generated data.
